item.title: Morning brief, Monday November 23
item.description: Good morning Sydney. Before you open Instagram or TikTok: did you get footage from the F1 weekend in Vegas? Pick your best clips, cut one quick recap reel, and post it before your flight, then spend thirty minutes replying to comments and messages. Today's one big thing is that F1 recap, posted before you leave for the airport. Your other must-dos: pay the UPS import fee for your Packengers shipment, reply to Brett's reservation request on Vrbo, and check on the home alarm and power alerts from Sunday afternoon. Your schedule: you and Gabe fly from Las Vegas to Denver this afternoon, departing at one forty four Pacific and landing at four forty three Mountain time. The weather in Las Vegas is sunny and cool, a high near sixty. Denver is cloudy with a high around forty one, dropping near thirty tonight, so keep a warm layer handy for landing. Wednesday, Gabe has his call with Ahmad at two Pacific, and Thursday morning is the train to Granby. Have a great travel day.
